name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Split.preimage_correlated_copy
title: A correlated copy adds no constraint: preimages under [B; R B] of [P; R P] have the law of preimages under B of P
statement: For B (n x m), R (n' x n) and P (n x k) over Z_q: stacking the rows R B under B and the targets R P under P does not change the coset Gaussian preimage law: Trapdoor.preimage [B; R B] [P; R P] tau = Trapdoor.preimage B P tau. In the positional GGH15 WE candidate this is the exact identity "correlated copy = merged" for the accept-class split.
